fact: Statistics South Africa published Marriages and Divorces 2024 (P0307) on 19 March 2026, compiled from two administrative sources: Department of Home Affairs marriage registration records (forms DHA-30, DHA-31, DHA-32, National Population Register) and divorce forms from the courts of the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development and Office of the Chief Justice (Stats SA divorce form 07-04); it is the annual series, the 2023 edition being the previous one.
title: Marriages and Divorces 2024, Statistical release P0307
